title: Missing information
objective: Complete a research task where critical input information is intentionally missing; identify uncertainty rather than inventing facts.

title: Tool failure recovery
objective: Complete a task where the primary data source becomes unavailable midway through execution.

title: Conflicting evidence
objective: Resolve a task containing conflicting sources and explicitly justify the selected evidence.

title: Invalid artifact
objective: Continue a multi-step workflow after an intermediate task returns output that violates its declared schema.

title: Requirement change
objective: Adapt an in-progress workflow after the acceptance criteria change midway through execution.

title: CSV analysis
objective: Analyze a customer dataset, identify meaningful trends, and produce a decision-oriented summary.

title: Metric diagnosis
objective: Investigate a sudden drop in a product metric and identify the most plausible drivers.

title: Anomaly detection
objective: Find anomalous patterns in a structured dataset and distinguish data-quality issues from real signals.

title: Alternative comparison
objective: Compare several business alternatives using explicit criteria and recommend a choice.

title: Decision analysis
objective: Build a quantitative recommendation from a small dataset with stated assumptions.

title: Migration plan
objective: Create a phased migration plan for moving a production application to a new database architecture.

title: Architecture plan
objective: Design an architecture for a multi-tenant AI application with clear trust boundaries.

title: Release plan
objective: Create a production release plan with validation gates, rollback, and ownership.

title: Implementation roadmap
objective: Turn a broad product objective into an ordered engineering roadmap with dependencies.

title: Dependency impact
objective: Determine which components are affected by a proposed architectural change and why.

title: Technology landscape
objective: Research the current landscape of AI agent orchestration frameworks and identify the major architectural patterns.

title: Technology comparison
objective: Compare two AI orchestration approaches and recommend one for a small engineering team.

title: Competitive analysis
objective: Analyze competitors in AI workflow orchestration and identify differentiated positioning opportunities.

title: Market research
objective: Assess whether developer-facing AI orchestration infrastructure is a viable SaaS opportunity.

title: Vendor evaluation
objective: Evaluate three AI platform vendors for an orchestration workload and produce a scored recommendation.

title: Python debugging
objective: Diagnose a failing Python service from logs, identify the root cause, and propose a tested fix.

title: TypeScript debugging
objective: Diagnose a TypeScript API failure and determine the smallest safe remediation.

title: API feature
objective: Implement a REST API feature with validation, persistence, tests, and error handling.

title: Frontend feature
objective: Implement a frontend feature against an existing API while preserving existing behavior.

title: Refactor
objective: Refactor a duplicated service layer without changing observable behavior.

title: Test coverage
objective: Identify high-risk untested paths in a repository and create a prioritized test plan.

title: CI diagnosis
objective: Investigate a failing CI pipeline and distinguish environment failures from product failures.

title: Production readiness
objective: Audit an application for production readiness across reliability, security, testing, and deployment.

title: Security remediation
objective: Analyze a security finding, determine exploitability, and propose a verifiable remediation.

title: Deployment preparation
objective: Prepare an application for staging deployment, including configuration validation and smoke-test planning.
